overlaps.conflict_description: Both workspaces display file trees but with different purposes. Notes shows .md files, IDE shows all project files. Should consolidate tree component logic.
Different debounce times across workspaces. Notes uses 500ms, IDE uses 2000ms. Should use unified auto-save hook.
Same component and store used but with different sync services. Should use unified sync service pattern.
Both use UnifiedChatPanel but Notes has AIPromptDialog while IDE has AgentChatPanel with approvals. Should unify AI interface.
Both use StorageAdapterFactory but IDE creates adapters directly while Notes uses via NotesFileSyncService wrapper. Consolidation opportunity.
